payload.session: uuid — the session the place joins
payload.scene: uuid | null — optional, the scene of that session the place joins (scene-links-same-campaign); absent, the session's first scene
payload.place: uuid — a place (« lieu ») of the session's campaign (scene-links-same-campaign), linked after the scene's last element; linked to it already, the one link stays. Its media are the session's through session_media_view, never stored (session-media-by-place)
